items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: This guy was spectacular. He knew all the arrangements, everything. And the movements that he made were classic

ctx.x: In those days, the big bands had an entertainer... In fact, Doc Palmer's band had an entertainer who sang and directed the band. His name was Alex McKinney, and he used to try to imitate Cab Calloway -- we used to call him Cab. But he'd sing... We didn't have a microphone; you know, he'd sing through the megaphone during those days.

But getting back to the other band... They had a guy who was an entertainer. This man was so spectacular, named Cleophus Jackson. The Gay(?) Floyd Orchestra... This guy was spectacular. He knew all the arrangements, everything. And the movements that he made were classic, before this... He was a whole production himself, you know.
